# Sirach Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_009_page_001.jpg

---

1 Don't be a jealous husband — you'll end up teaching your wife tricks she can use against you.

2 Don't surrender your heart to a woman to the point where she controls you.

3 Don't go near a promiscuous woman — you'll end up caught in her trap.

4 Don't spend time with female performers — they'll use their arts to ensnare you.

5 Don't stare at a young woman — you'll stumble into trouble and face consequences.

6 Don't waste yourself on prostitutes — you'll throw away your inheritance.

7 Don't wander the streets looking around. Don't hang around in desolate parts of the city.

8 Look away from a woman who is beautiful. Don't let yourself linger over someone else's beauty. Many men have been destroyed by a woman's beauty — it ignites desire the way a spark ignites a fire.

9 Never lie down next to a married woman at a banquet. Don't share a drinking cup with her. The pull of attraction may start small, and end with you sliding into ruin.

10 Don't walk away from an old friend. No new friend can replace him. A new friend is like new wine — let time work on it, and you'll enjoy it far more.

11 Don't envy a sinner's prosperity — you have no idea how their story ends.

12 Don't take pleasure in what brings ungodly people pleasure. Remember: they will not escape to the grave without punishment.

13 Keep a wide distance from someone with the power to kill you. That way you won't be living in fear of death. But if you have to interact with such a person, be careful not to offend — they could take your life. You are walking among snares; you are stepping over hidden nets.

14 Take time to read the people around you as well as you can. Get advice from those who are wise.

15 Let your conversations be with people of real understanding. Let the teachings of the Most High fill your discussions.

16 Share your table with the righteous. Let reverence for the Lord be the thing you are proud of.

17 Just as a craftsman is recognized by the quality of their work, so a wise leader is recognized by the quality of their words.

18 A person who talks too freely is a hazard to their community. Careless speech earns nothing but resentment.
